sinopsis.es: Dos vidas en paralelo: Dante Alighieri, poeta del siglo XIV, sufre con su «Divina comedia», y Nick Tosches, escritor del siglo XXI, recibe de un capo de la mafia el encargo de robar un manuscrito de esa obra maestra. Oscar Isaac interpreta a ambos.
sinopsis.en: Lives run in parallel in Julian Schnabel’s ode to art and the ineffability of creativity as Oscar Isaac takes on the dual roles of 14th Century poet Dante Alighieri, who is agonizing over his Divine Comedy, and 21st century author Nick Tosches, who is tasked by a mafia don to steal a handwritten manuscript of the poet’s masterpiece.
